whyNoLargerTreatmentCohort: The mission's own instruction is to make every change defensible, not to force a count. Given 5 of the top 12 candidates turned out to be genuinely protected (2 actively measuring), and 2 more have already-shipped, too-recent-to-re-judge fixes, forcing additional edits onto the remaining safe-but-unaudited pages (Webex, Confluence) without an identified specific weakness would be exactly the kind of unforced, non-defensible change this mission explicitly warns against.
